1230:       # affected by terrain

1232:         score_change = 10
1233:         if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
1234:           score_change -= 8 if battle.field.terrain != :None
1235:         end

1237:         # Prefer if allies have any damaging Ground moves they'll be able to use
1238:         # on a grounded foe, and vice versa
1239:         ai.each_foe_battler(b.side) do |b2, j|
1240:           next if !b2.has_damaging_move_of_type?(:GROUND)
1241:           score += (user.opposes?(b2)) ? -8 : 8
1242:         end
1243:       end

1245:       # Drop being used on foes
1246:       if b.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0
1247:         score += (user.opposes?(b)) ? -8 : 8

1249:       # Gravity raises accuracy of all moves; prefer if the user/ally has low

1255:       # sky-based attacks

1259:                                     "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct")
1260:         score += (user.opposes?(b)) ? 10 : -10
1261:       end
1262:     end
1263:     next score
